analysis: Separation of still-active errors from corrected ones by Prefix detectors

negatives.recovered_clean: labels.prefix[t]=0 and labels.prefix[s]=1 for some earlier retained position s<t of the same trajectory
negatives.fresh_clean: labels.prefix[t]=0 and labels.prefix[s]=0 for every earlier retained position s<t

score: each detector's frozen selected-layer VAL Prefix score, as saved by its original run; no retraining or inference
integrity_checks: saved position ids equal the dataset loader's ids in order
recomputed VAL Prefix AUROC equals the AUROC recorded at selection
published Streaming cells matched to source runs by freeze SHA256

pair_split.between: inherited and clean positions from different trajectories
pair_split.within: both positions from the same trajectory
pair_split.within_trajectory_mean: per-trajectory AUROC averaged over trajectories containing both classes
